verdict.rationale: Missive documents ways to act across many conversations: AI agents connected through its MCP server can triage new conversations and summarize the inbox, and rules automate actions on every matching conversation. But no documented bulk-select or batch operation exists, and the API rate limits (5 concurrent, 300/min) suggest per-item calls only. Missing for 10: documented multi-select bulk actions in the UI, batch or bulk API/MCP endpoints, any hands-on or independent corroboration of bulk operations at scale.
